name: module-preloaded-behind-an-unread-launcher
description: A script command behind a launcher option no table lists, here env --frobnicate, still names its files and packages: the file its --require=./setup.ts preloads and what only that file keeps live are held and not reported, the package its --require never-loaded preloads is used, and the manifest is noted. Since the option may make the command run any file, a file no command names is reported at the class possible, its exports falling with it, while a package no command names is still reported.
